risks: Revenue concentration is increasingly U.S.-weighted and government exposure can amplify policy/geopolitical sensitivity.
Model-provider data-retention/security policy can constrain deployments involving sensitive proprietary data.

Government concentration, procurement cycles and policy shifts can create lumpy demand despite current acceleration.
Reliance on third-party frontier models creates data-governance and supplier-policy exposure for sensitive deployments.
Current growth rates are unusually high and should not be extrapolated without continued conversion evidence.
